ctx.x: And so, they left and went to Houston first, and by the time they got to Houston, he called me long distance. Nat Pierce called me. He said, 'Man, Woody want to talk to you.' I said, 'Yeah? What's the matter now?' He said, 'He just wants to tell you something that happened.' And so he put him on the phone. And first thing he said, 'Hey, Gus Dick -- now, wait, he got that from a florist we passed by. It was a name, see, and it was another name, Cockburn was the name. And so I would call him Woody Cockburn, one of…
And I told him about my rooms, and he went right on and got my rooms for me. He said, 'things have really changed down here.'
